verdict.rationale: Requesty documents a first-party MCP Gateway that agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, Roo Code and any MCP-compatible tool connect to for access to external tools. Supporting docs cover server registration, auth configuration, per-user keys and usage analytics. The gateway mainly proxies registered third-party MCP servers rather than exposing Requesty's own platform functions as tools. Missing for 10: evidence that Requesty's own capabilities (routing, keys, analytics) are exposed as MCP tools, concrete endpoint/setup details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
